text:
Sven: Quick sync — want to lock down how we expose audit events to customers. Two hot spots: RBAC field changes (we want to add role sets) and KMS metadata (we currently surface key ARNs).

Maria: +1. Saw a support case where a customer was confused by `actor.role` flipping from string -> array in last rollout. We need a compatibility path and clear docs for client-visible events. :eyes:

Alex: What if we split fields: `actor.roles` (machine array) + `actor.role_display` (single human string for logs/console)? That keeps machine parsing stable and gives a friendly string for customers.

Jamie: Agree on split. Also KMS: we should NOT send raw `kms_key_arn` to customers. Suggest `kms_key_id_hash` + `kms_key_alias_display` so ops can identify keys but no PII/ARN leakage.

Sven: Good. Also need to decide event naming style. Current mix of `verb.noun` and `noun:verb`. Proposal: standardize on `resource.action` (e.g., `model.deploy`, `key.rotate`) and add `display_text` for UIs. Keep `event_id` stable.

Maria: +1 for `resource.action`. One more: legal asked that any customer-visible text must be non-assertive (e.g., use "requested" vs "deleted by system") for incidents. We should add a `tone` guideline to the event docs.

Alex: Quick compatibility plan: 1) Ship v2 fields (`actor.roles`, `kms_key_id_hash`, `event_name` standardized) but keep the old fields in the payload for 3 months behind a feature flag. 2) Emit schema deprecation warnings to `internal.audit` only. 3) Add small migration snippet in SDK changelog.

Jamie: For validation — we need a contract test that runs in CI and checks:
- `event_name` matches regex `^[a-z0-9]+\.[a-z0-9]+$`
- If `kms_key_arn` present, fail (unless `env==internal`)
- `actor.roles` is array or absent
- `actor.role_display` <= 64 chars

security-bot: deploy-checker: CI contract tests added to `eng-platform` pipeline. See https://ci.internal/runs/1223 :white_check_mark:

Sven: Nice. On the customer-facing validation, product wants a small UI preview generator so PMs can review display_text before it goes customer-visible. Alex, can your team add a preview endpoint that renders `display_text` with placeholders?

Alex: Yes, can add `/api/audit/preview` that accepts sample payload and returns rendered `display_text`. Will add rate limit and auth. ETA: 2 sprints.

Maria: Ops question — when we hash `kms_key_id`, what's the algorithm? We should pick a stable, keyed HMAC (HKDF?) with a platform secret so customers can't correlate keys across tenants. Also rotation plan for the secret.

Jamie: HMAC-SHA256 with a per-region platform salt stored in KMS. Rotation: 90d, backfill support for 30d. We'll also emit `kms_key_id_version` so we can detect which hash scheme produced it.

Sven: Action items I can own:
- Draft short spec for event naming + machine/display split (Sven)
- Ship contract tests + CI gating (Jamie)
- Preview endpoint + changelog (Alex)
- KMS hashing spec + rotation plan (Jamie/Maria)
- Draft customer-facing doc and migration FAQs (Maria)

Sven: Anyone object to rolling this out behind an `audit_v2` flag for 3 months?

Maria: No objections. :+1:

Alex: OK. We'll also surface warnings in the hosted console during the opt-in window.

security-bot: reminder: security-review required for `kms` hashing doc. Label: `sec-review` created on the PR.

Sven: Thanks everyone. I'll post the draft spec in #eng-docs this afternoon. If you have edge cases (e.g., service accounts with >100 roles, nested resources like `project.dataset.table`) drop them here.

Jamie: One edge I care about: `resource.id` length. Some customers have long ARNs. We should canonicalize `resource.id_display` trimmed to 128 chars and keep `resource.id_hash` for canonical lookups.

Maria: Noted. Also add test case: simultaneous `role` and `roles` present from hybrid clients — ensure we prioritize `roles` and populate `role_display` from the first element.

Alex: Will add parser fallback behavior in SDK: if `roles` missing but `role` present, normalize into `roles: [role]`.

Sven: Perfect. Looping in legal and support after the draft. :rocket:
